;Business and economy
*The deputy governor of [[Sweden]]'s central bank, the [[Sveriges Riksbank|Riksbank]], says that the country is likely to become a [[cashless society]] within the next three to five years. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-sweden-cenbank-cashless/riksbank-predicts-sweden-will-be-cashless-within-five-years-idUSKBN1O327W (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Two people died while 18 others are injured when a tank truck caught fire and exploded in the city of [[Rieti]], [[Italy]]. [https://tg24.sky.it/roma/2018/12/06/rieti-esplosione-distributore-seconda-vittima-dna.html (Sky Tg24)]
*[[Tsunami]] waves reportedly strike parts of [[New Caledonia]] and northern [[Vanuatu]] following a magnitude 7.5 earthquake centered near the [[Loyalty Islands]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/radio-australia/programs/pacificbeat/vanuatu-and-new-caledonia-assess-tsunami-damage/10588206 (Australian Broadcasting Corporation)]
*A search and rescue operation is underway for 7 servicemen after an incident involving a [[US Marine Corp]] [[F/A-18]] fighter jet and a [[KC-130]] refueling aircraft off the coast of [[Japan]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-46462814 (BBC)]

;Law and crime
*The chief financial officer of [[Huawei]], [[Meng Wanzhou]], was arrested on 1 December in [[Vancouver]], [[Canada]]. She faces extradition to the [[United States]]. Huawei says she faces unspecified charges. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/12/05/tech/huawei-cfo-arrested-canada/index.html (CNN)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Claudia Sheinbaum]] takes office as [[Head of Government of Mexico City]], becoming the first woman and first Jewish person to serve as [[Mexico City]]'s mayor. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/mexico-citys-jewish-mayor-wants-to-be-identified-by-policies-not-ethnicity/ (JTA)]
*[[Politics of Luxembourg]]
**[[Xavier Bettel]] is sworn in for a second term as [[List of Prime Ministers of Luxembourg|Prime Minister]]. His [[Bettel–Schneider Ministry II|coalition government]] plans to make all public [[Transport in Luxembourg|transport]] completely [[Free public transport|free]] by next summer, a world's first. [https://www.irishtimes.com/news/world/europe/luxembourg-set-to-make-all-public-transport-free-in-world-first-1.3721549 (''The Irish Times'')]
*[[Death and state funeral of George H. W. Bush]]
**The casket for former U.S. President [[George H. W. Bush]] arrives at the [[Washington National Cathedral|National Cathedral]]. [https://www.politico.com/amp/story/2018/12/05/george-hw-bush-funeral-cathedral-1045748 (Politico)]
**[[U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] and former U.S. Presidents [[George W. Bush]], [[Jimmy Carter]], [[Barack Obama]], and [[Bill Clinton]] attend the ceremony alongside [[Chancellor of Germany|German chancellor]] [[Angela Merkel]] and Britain's [[Charles, Prince of Wales|Prince Charles]]. [https://amp.theguardian.com/us-news/live/2018/dec/05/george-hw-bush-funeral-trump-obama-us-politics-live-updates (''The Guardian'')]

;Science and technology
